research_integrity: The primary 2024 source motivates the quantitative question; the fundamental mapping lemma is credited to an older primary paper. The result has undergone self-review only, not independent mathematical assessment.
scientific_limitations: The count and rank-minimum hold for centralizers of permutations in full transformation monoids; extension to general noninvertible centralizing transformations is not claimed. Full mathematical proof is supplied, while a separate computational checker covers degree at most eight. Equivalent historical cyclic-set enumerations may exist; the 2003 cycle-divisibility result is prior work. Some bibliographic comparisons were not full-text exhaustive.
title: Rank enumeration and minimum retraction size in permutation-centralizer monoids
